The '''Belderone Contention''' was a conflict that took place during the [[Unification Campaigns]] of the [[900s BBY]]. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial Forces]] participated in this conflict, achieving a notable [[Battle of the Dandrian Ring|victory]] at the [[Dandrian Ring/Legends|Dandrian Ring]] that ended the contention.

==History==
The Belderone Contention took place at some point between [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] and [[900 BBY/Legends|900 BBY]].<ref name="EGtW" /> It shared its name with [[Belderone/Legends|Belderone]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Belderone sector/Legends|Belderone sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>

The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] interfered in this conflict as part of its [[Unification Campaigns]]. The Galactic Republic's [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial Forces]] fought with distinction at the conclusion of the Belderone Contention, bringing the conflict to a violent end at the [[Battle of the Dandrian Ring]].<ref name="EGtW" />

==Aftermath==
Some [[Time/Legends|time]] after the Belderone Contention and the Unification Campaigns, the Judicial Forces went on to play key roles in the [[Mandalorian Excision]] of [[738 BBY]], the [[Battles of the Black Delve]] in the [[690s BBY]], and the [[Utor Shock]] of [[602 BBY]].<ref name="EGtW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Belderone Contention was first mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGtW" />
